title: Workloads: Deployments, StatefulSets, DaemonSets, Jobs
summary: The controllers that run your pods: ReplicaSets and Deployments with rolling updates and rollbacks, blue/green and canary with labels, DaemonSets, StatefulSets with stable identity and storage, Jobs and CronJobs. Ends with deploying shipit-api.
objectives: Explain how a Deployment manages ReplicaSets and how a rolling update progresses with maxSurge and maxUnavailable
Use rollout status, history, undo, pause and resume, and diagnose a stuck rollout
Implement blue/green and canary releases with labels and Services
Explain StatefulSet identity, ordering, headless Services and volumeClaimTemplates
Configure Jobs (completions, parallelism, backoffLimit, TTL, indexed) and CronJobs (schedule, timezone, concurrencyPolicy)
Choose the right controller for a workload and deploy shipit-api with Postgres and Redis
